company.quotationTerms:
1. Prices are based on current market and subject to change without notice.
2. This quotation is valid for 15 days from the date of issue.
3. Quantities are estimated as per provided drawing/data; final quantities will be settled after site verification.
4. Warranty: as per manufacturer policy for supplied materials only.
5. VAT & IT as applicable will be added.
company.paymentTerms: 50% advance with work order, 50% on material delivery.
company.deliveryTerms: Delivery within 3-7 working days after confirmation. Unloading at client cost.
